dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Eh, you are still pretty new to this. A few mistakes here and there are to be expected...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Paimon just got a bit flustered when she remembered she was taking an exam...

choices.text: Guess we didn't prepare well enough...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Don't get discouraged. I also made all sorts of mistakes when I first started doing experiments. You know what they say — Practice makes perfect! I'll come back later and you can try again.
